math.title: File:Mathematics (cryptography) on a blackboard.jpg
math.author: David Malone
math.description: A photo of a traditional blackboard showing some mathematics written in chalk. In subject in mathematics is cryptography. The specific topic is Diffie-Hellman key exchange, which is used to establish a secret between two people (called Alice and Bob) in public. The calculation shows how a man-in-the-middle attack can be conducted by someone (called Mallory) who can manipulate messages that Alice and Bob send to one another. The chalk board is located in Maynooth University's Physics Hall.

go.title: File:7 Collection Eybl Great Britain - E. Kealey - Women of Britain say – GO.jpg
go.author: Edgar James Kealey / Hill, Siffken & Co.
go.description: Women of Britain say - GO! (1915). Military recruitment poster by E. Kealey (dates unknown). 76 x 51 cm (Collection #2411, Eybl collection, Vienna). Two women and a child stand at the window and see soldiers marching as they leave to join the war. After 1915, as voluntary enlistments in the British regular army began to subside, women were expected to perform their patriotic duty and send their men to war and wish them luck.
